The seafood-bowl restaurant inside Otaru's Sankaku Market doesn't take reservations, and its numbered tickets can run out before closing time. Save this checklist for your Otaru afternoon 👇

📌 Save this for your trip (times, prices and the route are here) 👉 https://japanbystation.com/otaru-from-sapporo-half-day-or-overnight

✅ YOUR OTARU HALF DAY

1️⃣ Take a Rapid Airport train from Sapporo: about 41 minutes, ¥800. Check it says Otaru; some stop short at Teine. Right-hand window for the sea.

2️⃣ Eat first. Sankaku Market is a minute from the station. Takinami Shokudo opens 7:00–17:00 and gives out same-day numbered tickets, so go early.

3️⃣ Walk about 10 minutes downhill to the canal, 1,140 m long.

4️⃣ Sakaimachi street: Kitaichi Glass lights 167 oil lamps by hand every morning, and the Otaru Music Box Museum is free to enter.

5️⃣ Be back at the canal by dusk, about 16:00 in winter, when the gas lamps come on.

6️⃣ Dinner on Sushi-ya-dori. Masazushi's last order is 20:30, and it closes on Wednesdays.

⚠️ THE MISTAKE TO AVOID

Planning the canal cruise for New Year. It doesn't sail over the holiday and restarts on 2 January 2027. Sankaku Market closes on 1 January too.
